Info.About: Condition AGC historical replay on observed positive process pipe temperatures
Info.Status: trajectory-replay boundary condition; not a counterfactual actuator model
Info.Semantics: PipeLow and PipeGrow are raw process temperatures distinct from *_min_sp/vip setpoints. Positive values drive heat exchange directly; zero/off codes retain the dynamic pipe state.

tPipeReplay.description: Observed rail-pipe process temperature when active; propagated state otherwise

tGroPipeReplay.description: Observed grow-pipe process temperature when active; propagated state otherwise

hBoilPipe.description: Bounded internal-state tracking used only for continuity into off-coded intervals

hBoilGroPipe.description: Bounded internal-state tracking used only for continuity into off-coded intervals

rPipeCovIn.definition: fir(aPipe, epsPipe, epsCovFir, tauIntLampFir * tauLampFir * tauThScrFirU * tauBlScrFirU * 0.49 * exp(-kFir * lai), tPipeReplay, tCovIn)

rPipeSky.definition: fir(aPipe, epsPipe, epsSky, tauIntLampFir * tauLampFir * tauCovFir * tauThScrFirU * tauBlScrFirU * 0.49 * exp(-kFir * lai), tPipeReplay, tSky)

rPipeThScr.definition: fir(aPipe, epsPipe, epsThScrFir, tauIntLampFir * tauLampFir * uThScr * tauBlScrFirU * 0.49 * exp(-kFir * lai), tPipeReplay, tThScr)

rPipeBlScr.definition: fir(aPipe, epsPipe, epsBlScrFir, tauIntLampFir * tauLampFir * uBlScr * 0.49 * exp(-kFir * lai), tPipeReplay, tBlScr)

hPipeAir.definition: sensible(1.99 * pi * phiPipeE * lPipe * (abs(tPipeReplay - tAir))**0.32, tPipeReplay, tAir)

rLampPipe.definition: fir(aLamp, epsLampBottom, epsPipe, tauIntLampFir * 0.49 * pi * lPipe * phiPipeE * exp(-kFir * lai), tLamp, tPipeReplay)

rIntLampPipe.definition: fir(aIntLamp, epsIntLamp, epsPipe, 0.49 * pi * lPipe * phiPipeE * (1-fIntLampCanDown), tIntLamp, tPipeReplay)

hGroPipeAir.definition: sensible(1.99 * pi * phiGroPipeE * lGroPipe * (abs(tGroPipeReplay - tAir))**0.32, tGroPipeReplay, tAir)

hObservedRailPipeDemand.definition: rPipeSky + rPipeCovIn + rPipeCan + rPipeFlr + rPipeThScr + hPipeAir + rPipeBlScr - rLampPipe - rIntLampPipe - rLedPipe
hObservedRailPipeDemand.description: Implied rail-pipe heat needed to sustain the observed process temperature; compare with railPipePeak

hObservedGrowPipeDemand.description: Implied grow-pipe heat needed to sustain the observed process temperature; compare with growPipePeak
